In the oscillatory colored-noise regime \(4a	au>1\), define \(\mu=\sqrt{(4a	au)^2-1}\) and \[A= rac{\mu}{2\pi}\log\! rac{M}{|c_3|}.\]Then the total number of genuine sudden transitions of the classical/quantum-correlation dynamical phase over all \(

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the theorem; deterministic root-count replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact all-time count of genuine sudden transitions, sharp memory-parameter staircase boundaries, and large-memory count asymptotics for the source random-telegraph Bell-diagonal model.
integrity.ownership_basis: The mathematical bibliographic record for DOI:10.1142/S021974991100754X lists primary MSC 81P45, followed by 81S22 and 94A40.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The random-telegraph channel, damping function, Bell-diagonal evolution, frozen-discord class, and qualitative existence of multiple sudden transitions are credited to the cited sources.

scientific_limitations: Applies to valid Bell-diagonal initial states with 0<|c3|<max(|c1|,|c2|) under identical local random-telegraph dephasing.
The closed multiple-transition count is stated for the oscillatory regime 4 a tau > 1.
Tangential threshold contacts are not counted because they do not exchange the dominant correlation branch.
A closely related 2025 article was available only as publisher-preview material, leaving a specific residual originality risk.
title: Exact transition staircase for frozen discord under random-telegraph dephasing
